description: Free commerce advisor: describe a product, store, merchant-risk or coupon goal to get a tool, price, free-call balance and request preview. Never executes requests. For one known product use universal_product_url_to_json. Company research and additional workflows require the full /mcp profile.

inputSchema.description: Provide agent_goal or query. If both are present they must be identical. The server validates this rule.

examples.agent_goal: Find the tech stack of a company

agent_goal.description: Describe the research goal so the advisor can recommend a tool and estimate its list price.

budget_usd.description: Optional USD budget used for recommendations only; this does not authorize spending or payment.

domain_count.description: Number of companies you plan to research, used for batch sizing and cost estimates.

query.description: Alias for agent_goal; provide one goal field, or identical values when both are present.

sample_domain.description: Optional bare public company domain for a concrete request example and existing cached hints; no new lookup is run.

name: ask_hirepulse_advisor

outputSchema.description: Fields only; full schema in GET /v1/catalog.

cached_hint.description: Today only, status metadata; no result data or new engine calls.

cost_estimate_usd.description: List-price range before free quota, actual data availability and optional follow-up calls; includes request splitting and scan limits.

recommended_tool.description: Recommended data tool, or null when the goal is unclear.

title: HirePulse Advisor (free)
